title: A gate is classed push by a push action, not by the words origin or remote
goal: bl_authority classes a gate push when its question or options name a push, publish or remote write, not when they only mention origin/main or a remote url, so a worker's read-only question is not operator-only

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as b
item = {'id': 'ST-x', 'touches': ['kb/public/**'], 'goal': 'research gaps'}
qs = ['How is the stale eval row, which fails the eval on origin/main, resolved?', 'How does a census brief give a session a git ls-remote line?']
bad = [q for q in qs if b.gate_class(item, {'question': q, 'options': ['a', 'b'], 'recommendation': 'a'}) == 'push']
print(len(bad), 'read-only questions classed push:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
